questions.q: True or false? In a touchline press, the PIVOT also runs at the ball.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The LEFT ALA presses the ball, and the PIVOT takes away the inside return.
choiceExplanations: Two players on the ball leave the inside pass open. The PIVOT blocks the return instead.
Right, it's false. The LEFT ALA presses the ball, and the PIVOT takes away the inside return.

questions.q: Blue wants to pass back inside. Which picture shows the press done right?
options: PIVOT joins the ALA at the ball
PIVOT stands in the pass back inside
questions.explain: Yes. The ALA presses, and the PIVOT blocks the return, so Blue is stuck by the line.
choiceExplanations: The PIVOT is too far away. Blue can pass back inside and escape the press.
Two players on the ball leave the inside pass wide open for Blue.

questions.q: Now the press is on the right side. Drag the PIVOT to finish the press.
options: Space in the pass back inside
Space next to the pressing ALA
questions.explain: Yes. The RIGHT ALA presses the ball, so the PIVOT closes the pass back inside.
